course_text: Introduction to Information Systems. Role of information systems in organizations, hardware and software fundamentals, and the use of information technology to support business operations and decision making.
Programming Fundamentals. Problem solving and algorithm design using Python. Variables, control structures, functions, lists and file handling, with an emphasis on structured program development.
Object-Oriented Programming. Classes, objects, inheritance and polymorphism using Java. Exception handling, collections, and the design of maintainable object-oriented applications.
Database Management Systems. Relational database design, entity-relationship modeling, normalization, and writing SQL queries for data definition, manipulation and reporting.

Systems Analysis and Design. Requirements elicitation and documentation, feasibility study, structured and object-oriented analysis, use cases, and system specification for information systems projects.
Data Communications and Computer Networks. Network topologies, the TCP/IP protocol stack, routing and switching, wireless networks, and network configuration and troubleshooting.
Information Security Management. Threats and vulnerabilities, cryptography basics, access control, risk assessment, security policies, and protecting organizational information assets from intrusion.
Business Intelligence and Data Analytics. Data warehousing, ETL processes, OLAP, and building interactive dashboards and visual reports with Power BI to support management decision making.
Enterprise Resource Planning Systems. Integrated business processes across finance, procurement and logistics using SAP and Oracle ERP, including configuration, implementation and change management.
Web Application Development. Client-side and server-side development, HTML, CSS and JavaScript, database-backed web applications, and deployment of interactive web systems.
IT Project Management. Project scope, work breakdown structures, scheduling and budgeting, risk management, agile and waterfall methodologies, and leading project teams to delivery.
Business Process Management. Modeling and analyzing business processes using BPMN, workflow design, process improvement and automation of organizational procedures.
Principles of Financial Accounting. The accounting cycle, journal entries, ledgers and trial balance, and the preparation of income statements and balance sheets under accepted accounting standards.
Digital Marketing. Social media campaign planning, search engine optimization, content marketing, email campaigns, and measuring digital campaign performance and audience engagement.
Human Resource Management. Recruitment and selection, job analysis, training and development, performance appraisal, compensation, and employee relations within organizations.
Business Communication. Professional writing, presentation delivery, meeting facilitation, teamwork and collaboration, and communicating technical information to non-specialist audiences.
